item.title: Indian PM Narendra Modi arrives in Malaysia for two-day working visit
item.description: SEPANG: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Malaysia on Saturday to begin a two-day official visit. The plane carrying Modi landed at Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA) at 4.40 pm. Modi’s arrival was welcomed by Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim.
